title: hv's calls from 0084 to 0086: README's platforms and Status, the runbook's kovacs line, restart.md's check, Molt-matts' unread tables and pplr's os
body:
## What

0084's sweep left hv four calls on the docs and the user stack, and 0086 one more, carried in `intent/wip.md`'s TODO. hv, 4 Nov 2026, in molt-dc's session: go, on dc's recommendations.

1. README's platform list names Intel Macs, Fedora and RHEL, Arch and WSL2, which no sleeve runs and no test covers, and its Status says "Early development" at 1.4.2. The sleeves run macOS on Apple silicon (rhadamanth, gyges), Ubuntu 26.04 ARM64 (kovacs) and Raspberry Pi OS trixie ARM64 (farcaster, pihole). Recommendation taken: keep the others, labelled as written for and not yet run.
2. `docs/guides/bootstrap-runbook.md` says kovacs moves to brew only, through kovacs-sysadm (ST0008). Whether it has needs the live sleeve: a read-only look on kovacs, then a line that says what is there.
3. `.claude/restart.md`'s Quick Verification runs the suite under each bash by hand; `bin/devbin test all` runs both, as `intent/llm/RULES.md` says since 0087.
4. Molt-matts: the `[sleeve]` tables in five `molt.toml`s, the `[instance]` tables in six `instance.toml`s and the `MOLT_PLATFORM` exports in five `vars.sh`s are read by nothing, as 0085 found for the skeleton, which lost them. kovacs's `[instance]` table already says ubuntu-24.04 for a sleeve on 26.04.
5. Molt-matts: rhadamanth and gyges enable pplr with `os = ["linux", "macos"]`, while the formula is for macOS on Apple silicon alone (0086's note).

## Not this issue

- bl0001's advice to publish the login PATH for GUI launches waits with ac's hold on bl0001, read again before it goes to print.
- `AGENTS.md`'s test command is Intent's default for shell, Intent issue 0672.

## Next

dc: 1 to 3 go on main by pathspec as docs, with a CHANGELOG line under 1.4.3; 4 and 5 are one Molt-matts commit once hv's 1.4.2 run on rhadamanth is done. Proof for 4 and 5: nothing in Molt or Molt-matts reads what goes, and `molt doctor` on rhadamanth reads the same before and after.


## Done so far (dc, 4 Nov 2026)

- 1 to 3 on main at dc856ce: the README's platform list and Status, the runbook's kovacs line from kovacs-sysadm's read-only probe (Homebrew's molt 1.4.2 is the only molt on kovacs's PATH, with no `~/bin/molt` or `~/.local/bin/molt`), and `.claude/restart.md`'s `bin/devbin test all`. The CHANGELOG opens `## [1.4.3] - unreleased` with it.
- 4 and 5, the `molt.toml` half: Molt-matts 3d1de92 on main, unpushed, for hv to push. The `[sleeve]` tables are gone and pplr is `os = ["macos"]` on rhadamanth and gyges. `molt doctor` on rhadamanth reads the same before and after.
- 4, the `vars.sh` and `instance.toml` half: Molt-matts branch `dc/0090-vars-instance` at 2f95dfe, unpushed. `MOLT_PLATFORM` and the `[instance]` tables go, and the facts only `[instance]` held move into each `vars.sh` header: kovacs on Ubuntu 26.04 under Parallels on rhadamanth, and farcaster's and pihole's boards and roles. `vars.sh` is an input to every render, so any edit to it makes doctor fail on every rendered file until `molt upgrade` re-renders them, though no output changes. That is 5 of 24 liberators on rhadamanth, measured and put back at once. `instance.toml` alone leaves doctor as it was.

## hv's ruling (4 Nov 2026, in molt-dc's session)

"yes, land the held branch before the 1.4.3 upgrade". dc cherry-picks 2f95dfe onto Molt-matts main just before hv's 1.4.3 `molt upgrade` on rhadamanth, unpushed, for hv to push with 3d1de92. Each other sleeve then takes it with its own `molt upgrade`, which pulls and re-renders in one run. This issue closes once it has landed.
